results.title: Adaptive Maths & Reading App for Primary Kids | Ziado
results.snippet:
Adaptive Maths & Reading App for Primary Kids | Ziado

# Learning that meets your child exactly where they are. 

 Ziado maps your child's real skills, finds the gaps, and builds short game-like maths and reading quests around them - one confident step at a time. 

- Aligned to the Australian Curriculums
- No account needed to try
- Made in Australia

 

- Maths: Foundation – Level 6
- Reading: Foundation – Level 4
- Built on the Australian Curriculums

## Not a one-size worksheet. A living map of what your child actually knows.

 Every skill - from "add within 20" to "read words with sh" - is a stepping stone connected to the ones before it. Ziado quietly tracks how confident your child is on each one, and only opens the next step when the earlier ones are genuinely solid. 

 Each round of ~10 questions is built for your child on the spot: a warm-up they'll nail, practice on today's skill, the same idea shown a new way, and one small stretch. Difficulty follows real evidence from their answers - never a fixed script. 

How the adaptive engine works 

## Every planet is a set of skills to master.

 Your child's home screen is a real-time 3D galaxy. Chart a course, clear the quests, take on the boss, and light up your galaxy. 

 

### Worlds

Each planet, star or comet is a cluster of related skills - the Number world, the Shapes & Space world, and more.

### Quests

A glowing quest trail links the worlds, so there's always a clear "what's next" - never an overwhelming menu.
